questions.question: Which two theorems use the exact same $p$-adic valuation $v_p$?

options.text: The $p$-adic ultrametric ($\S 7$) and Legendre's factorial prime-power formula ($\S 9$)
Hall's matching theorem and Schur's theorem

questions.explanation: Both rely on $v_p(n)$: $d_p(x, y) = p^{-v_p(x-y)}$ forms an ultrametric, while $v_p(n!) = (n - s_p(n))/(p-1)$ drives Bertrand's postulate.

questions.question: Which analytic theorem proves Revenue Equivalence across symmetric auction formats ($\S 12$)?
questions.explanation: Applying the Envelope theorem to $U(v) = \max_\beta (v - \beta)P(\text{win} \mid \beta)$ gives $U'(v) = v^{n-1}$ independently of the payment rule.

questions.question: What geometric objects share the exact polyhedral shape of the 3D $\ell_1$ unit ball $|x| + |y| + |z| \le 1$?
questions.explanation: The 3D $\ell_1$ unit ball has vertices $(\pm 1, 0, 0), (0, \pm 1, 0), (0, 0, \pm 1)$, forming a regular octahedron of volume $4/3$.

questions.question: Which pair of Platonic dihedral angles sum to $180^\circ$, enabling space-tiling matching the FCC sphere packing voids?
questions.explanation: $\arccos(1/3) + \arccos(-1/3) = 70.53^\circ + 109.47^\circ = 180^\circ$, so two tetrahedra and two octahedra fill $360^\circ$ around every edge.
